map.有效半衰期一定更短？: Is the effective half-life always shorter?
map.是，物理与生物两条清除途径叠加，te 小于 tp 与 tb 中较小者。: Yes; physical and biological clearance combine, so te is less than the smaller of tp and tb.
map.生物半排期是什么？: What is the biological half-excretion period?
map.机体代谢/排泄使核素量减半的时间，与放射性衰变并存。: The time for the body's metabolism/excretion to halve the radionuclide amount, coexisting with radioactive decay.
